written_when: at the end of a turn in which a skill was loaded, opened with read, or proposed; never for a turn without skill activity; one per chain stage
counters_absent_when: no skill was loaded, opened or proposed
fired_name: the skill's id (filename stem); tokens is estimateTokens of the block applySkills adds to the prompt
read: skill id to the number of successful reads of .gnomon/skills/<id>.md
cited_in_reasoning: ids of fired or opened skills whose id or name appears, whole-word and case-insensitive, in the turn's reasoning; names under 4 characters and names made only of generic words never match
proposed: ids the skill tool wrote to skills/proposed/ this turn
derived_not_requested: nothing here is reported by the model; there is no self-reported outcome field
delegation: a delegated sub-turn's skills are merged into its parent's record
signals_note: printed by gnomon skill mine and returned in its --json as skill_signals; they are about existing skills and are not written to .gnomon-skills/candidates/
